plugins.name: CommandCode Provider
plugins.description: Native commandcode.ai provider with weighted multi-key pool, per-key proxy and failover: routes DeepSeek/GLM models through api.commandcode.ai with reasoning normalized to reasoning_content, so /v1/messages renders thinking blocks. Model claims are configurable and the plugin does not rewrite model names unless told to, leaving alias resolution to the host.
plugins.author: ahoo
